source.description:
A module exporting `async function main({ macro, run, routine,
trigger, steps }: StepContext)`: `run` is this run (its time, zone and
the previous run), `trigger` what started it (a schedule, an event and
its item, or a person), `steps` the typed outputs of the steps before
it. What `main` returns, as JSON of at most 64 KB, is the step's output.

summary.description: One or two sentences on how, for the routine's owner.

title.description: What the step does, in a few words, e.g. "Label invoices".

reason.description: Why the routine needs its owner.

oneOf.description: The saved rewrite, or the rewrite that failed its checks.

toSdk.description: The SDK it was brought to.

oneOf.description: The triggering content answered the condition with no.

probability.description: The classifier's probability, from 0 to 1, that the answer was yes.

oneOf.description: The condition could not be checked before the retry window closed.

EventFilter.description:
An event name AND an entity ID must match within the same filter. A
condition further requires the event's content to answer it with yes.

`github` comes from outside Macro and carries its payload: it stands
alone in its filter, takes no ids, and may require
exact payload values with `match`. A `github` filter narrows deliveries
with its `github` selector.

Yes/no question about the triggering content, e.g. "Is this email an
invoice?". The routine runs only when the answer is yes.

the owner. Agent ("Ask AI") steps keep their own agent attribution
either way: an agent session speaking as a person is a different
change. A single agent task has no code steps, so it never applies.

Who the action belongs to. Every action is user-owned today, but the
type no longer says so: the principal string on the wire and in the
`owner` column is the same, and a bot- or team-owned row decodes
rather than failing to parse.

run_visibility.description: Whether the action's runs are listed in Home and the Agents list.

oneOf.description:
Set on a routine one of another routine's runs created: the routine
it follows and the run that created it.

suggestion_id.description:
The routine suggestion it was saved from, if any: a plain pointer
that stays after the suggestion is replaced.

template_id.description: The shared template this routine was activated from, if any.

oneOf.description:
The latest finished run, with what each step did. Present only in
lists, and only once the routine has finished a run.

schedule.description: Deprecated: use `trigger.schedule`. Present only for cron actions.

timezone.description: Deprecated: use `trigger.timezone`. Present only for cron actions.

ScheduledActionResponse.description:
Canonical trigger plus deprecated cron fields for existing clients. Event
responses omit legacy fields rather than inventing a schedule or timezone.

ScheduledActionUpdate.description:
Live status update for a scheduled-action run, broadcast via the connection
gateway to the owner. Clients use the typed resource to navigate to the run
transcript and the variant tag to toggle the running indicator. `chat_id`
remains populated only for chat runs, for older clients.

Serialized with a `type` tag (`started`/`stopped`) and delivered over the
single `scheduled_action_update` message type on the gateway.

SdkFingerprint.description:
Identifies the SDK API code was type-checked against: its version and a
hash of its declarations, e.g. `0.2.2+18cc1c19c35c`.

ShareRoutineTemplate.description: What the owner supplies when sharing; the rest is snapshotted from the routine.

StartDraftJobRequest.description:
A background draft to start: what the blocking route takes, and the id
the client made for this start.

clientId.description:
Made by the client, once per start. Sent again with it (as when the
connection drops before the answer), the start answers with the job
it began, starting nothing, until that job is discarded.

StepId.description:
Names a step's output: a lowercase letter, then up to 31 lowercase
letters, digits or underscores.

StepKind.description: Code written once, or Ask AI each run.

StepProblem.description: A drafted step whose code still fails the type checker.

index.description: Its place among the steps, from zero.

StepTitle.description: A step of a routine handed back.

title.description: Its title; empty when it has none.

SubRoutine.description: How a routine created by a routine's run belongs to that routine.

created_by_run_id.description:
The run that created it: the id of that run's history record, which
exists once the run ends.

key.description: The name its creating code gave it, when it gave one.

parent_id.description:
The top-level routine it follows: pausing that routine pauses it, and
deleting that routine deletes it. A routine a sub-routine's run
creates follows the same top-level routine.

paused_by_parent.description: It is off because its parent was switched off, and resumes with it.

SuggestOutcome.description: What became of a suggestion handed back.

oneOf.description: A drafted routine's check, as `macro.routines.check` returns it.

problems.description: Why it wasn't, to fix and suggest again.

oneOf.description: A catalog routine, with knob values.
Never set: a catalog pick is not shown among suggestions.
A routine the catalog lacks, checked as saving checks it.

card.description: How it shows in the person's Suggestions feed.

created.description: What the session created for it, as `macro.routines.check` takes.

SuggestRequest.description: What a suggestion session hands back through `macro.routines.suggest`.

oneOf.description:
A catalog routine (`GET /scheduled-actions/catalog`), with the knob
values AI filled in. Its trigger and steps come from the catalog.

knobs.description: Knob values by knob name; knobs left out keep the catalog's.

oneOf.description:
A routine AI drafted that passed saving's checks, as it would be
saved (switched off), for the person to review first.

SuggestedPick.description:
What is suggested: a catalog routine with its knobs, or a routine AI
drafted and checked.

allOf.description: Its kind, with that kind's data.

categories.description: The feed's filters it shows under.

dedupKey.description:
Names the suggestion across nights: proposing the same key again changes
this suggestion instead of adding one.

oneOf.description: A background prompt suggestion's latest run.

state.description: Where it is for the person.

stateChangedAt.description: When its state last changed, such as when it was dismissed.

stateReason.description: Why it was resolved; only on resolved suggestions.

summary.description: Why, in a line or two.

title.description: What to do, in a few words.

Suggestion.description: One proactive suggestion for one person.

SuggestionChanged.description: The suggestion changed since the caller read it.

suggestion.description: The suggestion as it is now, to show before acting on it again.

SuggestionFeed.description:
A person's feed: their open suggestions, best first, and the ones they
finished in the last day, newest first.

done.description: Suggestions done in the last 24 hours, with what they produced.

oneOf.description:
A prompt for an agent: opened in the composer, or run in the
background.

prompt.description: What the agent is asked to do.

sends.description:
For a background run that posts or sends something: what, and
where, in plain words. The card shows it before Run, and running
it approves exactly that. None when the run posts and sends
nothing.

oneOf.description: A note about specific items, with what to do about them.

action.description: What to do about the items.

oneOf.description:
A reply suggestion's draft, once a session wrote one: the email thread
it is in, with the draft as the part.
A routine suggestion, shown among suggestions.

SuggestionKind.description: What kind of suggestion it is, with that kind's data. A kind never changes.

SuggestionReview.description: Every suggestion AI made for the person, for a routines session.

keptLeft.description: Suggestions this session may still hand back.

SuggestionRun.description:
A run of a background prompt suggestion: a hidden agent session of the
person's, with the full toolset, that never stops to ask.

progress.description: How it is going, read from the session.

sessionId.description:
The agent session: open it to see the result or answer what it
waits for.

SuggestionState.description: Where a suggestion is for the person.

SuggestionWriteOutcome.description: What became of a session's write.

problems.description: Why it wasn't, to fix and try again.

oneOf.description: The suggestion as it now is.

SuggestionsReview.description:
What a generation session reads before managing the person's suggestions:
every suggestion they have, open or not, and how many more it may add.

newLeft.description: Suggestions this generation may still add or bring back.

open.description: Open suggestions the person has, and the most they may have.

openLimit.description: The most open suggestions a person may have.

suggestions.description:
Open suggestions first, best first, then closed ones newest first. A
dismissed suggestion's `stateChangedAt` is when the person dismissed it.

Surface.description: The part of the app a routine is about, where it is offered.

Target.description: An item, or a part of one such as a message in a thread.

partId.description: A part of it, such as one message in a channel.

oneOf.description: A person mentioned in the instructions, by their user ID.
A document, channel or other item mentioned in the instructions.

block_name.description: The mention's block name, such as `channel` or `md`.

oneOf.description: The time zone of the routine's schedules.

TemplateVariable.description: A user-specific part of a shared routine.

VariableFill.description: How a variable is filled when someone activates the template.
